Container.Name: domain-watchdog
Container.Overview: Domain Watchdog monitors domain names using RDAP, tracks their history, and helps you acquire them when they expire.[br][br]Requires an existing PostgreSQL and Redis container on the same Docker network.[br][br]Also deploy the domain-watchdog-worker container.[br][br]Before starting, create the database:[br]docker exec -it YOUR_POSTGRES_CONTAINER psql -U YOUR_USER -c "CREATE DATABASE domainwatchdog;"
Container.Requires: PostgreSQL container | Redis container | Both on the same Docker network | Also install domain-watchdog-worker

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port to access the Domain Watchdog web interface.

Config.Name: Caddy Data
Config.Description: Internal Caddy state storage.

Config.Name: Caddy Config
Config.Description: Internal Caddy configuration storage.

Config.Name: Public Content
Config.Description: User-uploaded public content. Create a home.md file here to customize the landing page.

Config.Name: JWT Passphrase
Config.Description: Passphrase used to encrypt JWT keypair. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32 — If changing this on an existing install, regenerate keys with: docker exec domain-watchdog php /app/bin/console lexik:jwt:generate-keypair --overwrite

Config.Name: App Environment
Config.Description: Leave as prod.

Config.Name: App Secret
Config.Description: Random secret key. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Set to true if behind a reverse proxy with SSL. Set to false for plain HTTP direct access.

Config.Name: Server Name
Config.Description: Internal Caddy binding. Leave as :80.

Config.Name: Outgoing IP
Config.Description: Your server's outgoing public IP address. Required for some domain connectors/registrars.

Config.Name: Enable Registration
Config.Description: Allow new users to register. Set to false to lock down the instance.

Config.Name: Verify Email on Registration
Config.Description: Require email verification on signup. Requires a working Mailer DSN.

Config.Name: Database URL
Config.Description: Full PostgreSQL connection string. Format: postgresql://USER:PASSWORD@CONTAINER_NAME:PORT/DATABASE?serverVersion=VERSION&charset=utf8

Config.Name: Redis Async DSN
Config.Description: Redis connection for async messages. Format: redis://CONTAINER_NAME:PORT/messages?lazy=1

Config.Name: Redis RDAP Low DSN
Config.Description: Redis connection for low-priority RDAP messages.

Config.Name: Redis RDAP High DSN
Config.Description: Redis connection for high-priority RDAP messages.

Config.Name: Redis Lock DSN
Config.Description: Redis connection for distributed locking. Format: redis://CONTAINER_NAME:PORT

Config.Name: Mailer DSN
Config.Description: SMTP connection for email alerts. Example: smtp://user:pass@smtp.example.com:587 — Leave as null://null to disable.

Config.Name: Mailer Sender Name
Config.Description: Display name for outgoing notification emails.

Config.Name: Mailer Sender Email
Config.Description: Sender address for outgoing notification emails.

Config.Name: OAuth Client ID
Config.Description: OAuth2/OIDC client ID. Leave blank to disable SSO.

Config.Name: OAuth Client Secret
Config.Description: OAuth2/OIDC client secret.

Config.Name: OAuth Authorization URL
Config.Description: OAuth2 authorization endpoint URL.

Config.Name: OAuth Token URL
Config.Description: OAuth2 token endpoint URL.

Config.Name: OAuth UserInfo URL
Config.Description: OAuth2 userinfo endpoint URL.

Config.Name: OAuth Scope
Config.Description: OAuth2 scopes to request. Example: openid profile email

Config.Name: SSO Auto Redirect
Config.Description: Automatically redirect to SSO login instead of showing the local login form.
